title: Mission - Aurora 7
description: Fifty years later, the flight of the fourth American in space (and second to orbit the Earth) is celebrated in this video tribute to Mercury astronaut Scott Carpenter produced by NASA Television.
keywords: PD NASA, Videos of films from NASA, Aurora 7
